liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, equal to cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, which covers the debt due within one year of {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}} without new funding.
Debt due within one year increased by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, so the refinancing task is larger than a year earlier even though cash liquidity exceeds it.

Free cash flow after lease payments rose by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}, equal to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2024}} of debt, broadly unchanged on the prior year.

Customer prepayments rose with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, and advance ticket cover increased by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Cash liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}} and the weakest of the group ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

Maturities: debt due within one year rose by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2024}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2024}}, which has to be met from cash and cash-like investments of {{cash_like@FY2024}} and from cash flow after leases of {{fcf_after_leases@FY2024}}.

Margins: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} as finance costs rose.
Shareholder returns: the Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share for the year, subject to approval from debt instrument holders.
